extra.message: User-controlled 'formulaExpression' (from the 'formula' multipart field in POST /api/leases/:id/renewal-forecast/custom-formula) is passed directly to 'new Function(...)'. This allows arbitrary JavaScript code execution on the server (RCE).

'exportPreset' is read from the user-controlled 'ledgerPreset' cookie and interpolated into a shell command string that is executed with shell=true via spawn(). An attacker can inject shell metacharacters to execute arbitrary OS commands.
'localeTag' comes from the user-controlled 'x-brochure-locale' header and is concatenated into a pandoc command executed via exec() (shell). This allows OS command injection.

'filterValue' (query param 'value' on GET /api/leases/saved-filter) is concatenated directly into a raw SQL string with single quotes, and 'filterColumn' (from config savedLeaseFilterColumn) is also interpolated unescaped. This allows SQL injection.

'packetLabel' from the request body (POST /api/leases/:id/renewal-offer/packet) is used in path.join() without basename sanitization, allowing path traversal to write arbitrary files (e.g. '../../...').

'checklistType' from the route param :checklistType (GET /api/inspections/checklists/:checklistType) is joined into a path without basename sanitization, allowing path traversal to read arbitrary .md files on the server.
'filename' is taken from the user-controlled multipart upload part.filename and used in path.join() without sanitization, allowing path traversal to write files outside the intended media directory.

'brandingThemeName' is joined into a file path without basename sanitization, allowing path traversal to read arbitrary .json files. The value is sourced from workflow config (set via PATCH /api/settings/workflow-preferences), which is attacker-influenced through unvalidated Object.assign.

readDispatchHandoffToken() uses app.jwt.decode() which does NOT verify the JWT signature. The unauthenticated endpoint POST /api/tickets/:id/dispatch-confirmation calls this, so an attacker can forge an unsigned token with any ticketId and mark tickets InProgress. Signature verification is bypassed (contrast readInspectionAccessToken which uses jwt.verify).

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: applyHouseholdDetailsUpdate() Object.assign's the entire unvalidated request body onto both the TenantProfile and the User entity. A tenant (PATCH /api/tenant/household-details) can set 'role' to 'property_admin', reset 'disabled', or overwrite other fields, achieving privilege escalation.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: importSyndicatedListingFeed() fetches an arbitrary user-supplied 'feedUrl' (GET /api/properties/feed-import) with no URL/host validation, allowing Server-Side Request Forgery against internal network resources.

resolveVendorGateDecision() grants access (escalationTier 99) based on the client-supplied 'x-vendor-role' header equaling 'admin', rather than the authenticated user's actual role. An attacker can set this header to bypass the vendor gate access check (GET /api/vendors/gate-decision). The same flaw exists in resolveFieldStaffGateDecision at line 123.

resolveTourConfirmationRedirect() returns the user-controlled 'x-redirect-url' header (partnerReturnUrl) verbatim, and the endpoint replies with reply.redirect(). This is an open redirect (CWE-601) that can be used for phishing/credential stealing. Contrast resolveVendorHandoffRedirect which validates against an allowlist.

'trackingId' (route param :trackingId) is interpolated unescaped into an XPath expression. An attacker can inject additional predicates (e.g. ' or @status='delivered') to alter query logic and enumerate records. Contrast findReturnShipmentByReference which escapes the value.

searchStaffDirectory() builds an LDAP filter with the user-supplied 'searchTerm' (POST /api/staff/directory-search) without escaping. The escapeLdapFilterValue() helper exists but is only used in verifyGroupMembership, so this endpoint is vulnerable to LDAP injection.

resolvePremiumDocumentByTier() gates document access solely on a client-controlled 'membershipTier' cookie. Any authenticated user can set membershipTier=premium and read any document by id (GET /api/documents/:id/tier-preview) without ownership/visibility checks (IDOR). Contrast resolvePremiumDocumentForTenant which checks tenant ownership.

evaluateSyndicatedListingAccess() decides eligibility using a truthy check on 'feedResult.access', but feedResult is the raw request body (client-controlled). An attacker can pass feedResult={access:'true'} to force eligible=true. Contrast evaluateInspectionTemplateAccess which uses strict '=== true'.

recordScreeningLookupMiss() logs the full query object. The caller (GET /api/tenants/screening-lookup) passes query containing 'ssn' and 'email', so Social Security Numbers are written to the application logs.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: buildPortfolioVarianceReport() returns the error stack trace and internal context when the 'verbosity' query param equals 'trace' (GET /api/portfolio/variance-report). This discloses internal server details to any staff user.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: POST /api/tickets/:id/invoice-summary returns the full error stack trace when the 'reportLevel' query param is 'extended', disclosing internal server details to any authenticated staff user.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: renderCustomNotice() compiles a user-supplied 'templateBody' (POST /api/notices/broadcast) with Handlebars. This enables server-side template injection, allowing an attacker to control the rendered notification content via arbitrary template constructs.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: applyRenewalPacketDownloadHeaders() places the user-controlled 'exportName' (query param export_name) directly into the Content-Disposition header without stripping CR/LF, allowing HTTP header injection. Contrast applyInspectionSignoffDownloadHeaders which sanitizes newlines.

restoreDashboardLayoutState() parses XML from the user-controlled 'dashboardLayout' cookie without rejecting a DOCTYPE declaration, allowing XML External Entity injection risk. Contrast restoreTicketQueueLayoutState which explicitly rejects DOCTYPE.
A hardcoded bearer token ('7f3b1c9e2a6d...') is embedded in the source and used to authenticate to the accounting ledger service. Anyone with repository access can obtain this credential.

The vendor gate payload encryption key falls back to a hardcoded value ('brightfield-legacy-gate-payload-key') when GATE_PAYLOAD_KEY is unset, so anyone who knows the source can forge/decrypt gate payloads. The legacy path also uses AES-CBC without an authentication tag (no integrity check).

cwe: CWE-327: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

extra.message: State-changing operations are exposed via GET with no CSRF protection. GET /api/renewals/staff-offer/accept accepts a renewal offer (mutates lease status/endDate) via a plain GET request, making it vulnerable to CSRF (CWE-352) and violating safe HTTP method semantics.

applyLeaseAmendmentPayload() Object.assign's the entire unvalidated request body onto the Lease entity (PATCH /api/leases/:id/amendment), allowing a staff user to set arbitrary fields beyond the intended amendment fields. Contrast applyValidatedLeaseAmendment which validates with zod.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: applyAvailabilityWidgetHeaders() reflects the request Origin (or '*') into Access-Control-Allow-Origin without validation, allowing arbitrary cross-origin access to the public availability widget endpoint. Contrast applyPressKitHeaders which validates against an allowlist.

recordTicketEscalationNote() writes the user-supplied 'reason' directly into a log message without sanitization, allowing log injection/forgery via newline characters. Contrast recordRenewalDecisionNote which sanitizes CR/LF.

cwe: CWE-117: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs

extra.message: Quick-connect codes are only 6-digit numeric values (1M possibilities) hashed with fast SHA-256. The check-in/session endpoints accept these codes and are vulnerable to brute-force guessing, allowing unauthorized field-tablet sessions.

cwe: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

extra.message: relayScreeningPullToLegacyBureau() places the bureau access token into the URL query string (api_key=...) of a GET request. Secrets in URLs can leak via logs, referers, and proxies. Contrast relayScreeningPullToBureau which uses an Authorization header.

cwe: CWE-598: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings
